title: Mad Hatter vs Eldritch Horror
description: A pale woman with short black hair, dressed in a pink and white gothic Mad Hatter-style outfit, kneels on broken stone pavement while clutching her head in distress. Behind her looms a massive red eldritch monster with a giant central eye, sharp teeth, and numerous writhing tentacles, set against the backdrop of a distorted, pink-striped Notre-Dame cathedral under a magenta sky.
prompt: A gothic horror scene featuring a distressed female Mad Hatter character with pale skin and black hair kneeling on shattered stone ground, wearing a pink and white outfit with gold epaulets, clutching her head in terror. A gigantic red eldritch monster with one massive bloodshot eye, sharp teeth and dozens of fleshy tentacles emerges behind her.
